Run the **"Wrap up and push" protocol** in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md#wrap-up-and-push-protocol), step by step:

1. Run the inventory commands and show me the output.
2. State which row of the decision table applies and why, in one line, before touching git.
3. If you don't know whether I've verified the change in Xcode, ask me first.
4. Commit using the conventional-commit format with a `STABLE:` line where required.
5. Push, do the release check, and report.

Before committing, run the **Self-review** checklist from AGENTS.md on the diff and give me the one-line verdict.
